Black Orc High Priest of Orcus
CR 9

XP 6,400
Black orc cleric of Orcus 10
CE Medium humanoid (orc)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +3

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 13, flat-footed 18 (+6 armor, +1 deflection, +2 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 75 (10d8+20 plus 10)
Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +10; +4 vs. undead attacks
Defensive Abilities blessing of Orcus, death’s embrace, ferocity; DR 1/-

Speed 20 ft.
Melee +1 longspear +12/+7 (1d8+7/x3)
Ranged masterwork light crossbow +10 (1d8/19-20/x2)
Special Attacks channel negative energy (DC 18, 5d6) scythe of evil (5 rounds), spontaneous casting (inflict spells)
Domain Spell-like Abilities (CL 10th)

6/day—bleeding touch (1d6/round, 5 rounds), touch of evil (5 rounds)

Spells Prepared (CL 10th)

5th—dispel good (DC 18)D, slay living (DC 18), unhallow (DC 18)
4th—death wardD, divine power, lesser planar ally, spell immunity
3rd—animate deadD, bestow curse (DC 16), inflict serious wounds (2, DC 16), speak with dead
2nd—align weapon, bull’s strength, death knell (DC 15)D, desecrate, silence (DC 15), undetectable alignment
1st—bane (DC 14), curse water (DC 14), doom (DC 14), protection from goodD, inflict light wounds (DC 14), shield of faith
0 (at will)—bleed (DC 13), create water, detect magic, read magic
D domain spell; Domains Death, Evil

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 16, Cha 14
Base Atk +7; CMB +11; CMD 24
Feats Brew Potion, Empower Spell, Improved Initiative, Maximize Spell, Power Attack
Skills Intimidate +12, Knowledge (religion) +13
Languages Common, Orc
Combat Gear potion of cure moderate wounds, wand of blindness/deafness (8 charges); Other Gear +1 scale mail, ring of protection +1, +1 longspear, masterwork light crossbow, 10 bolts, 300 gp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Blessing of Orcus (Su)

Black orcs gain a +4 racial bonus on all saving throws made to resist any attack or effect created by an undead creature.
